g.text: Start-up: what F1R3Gaze does to its files before the window opens
no: another F1R3Gaze holds it, or it cannot be locked
the marker names a newer layout?
read only, with no busy flag:
nothing is written to a newer profile
busy flag there, or no marker?
yes: the last start did not finish
: sync every folder start-up writes into:
the skeleton, the roots' ancestors, the backups,
link targets' folders, the migration's plan
no barrier: the last start left nothing pending
(not synced: a power cut leaves nothing pending)
or create the marker of a new one
read only from here; the busy flag stays,
so the next start runs the barrier and resumes
each synced in its parent, and remove dead writers'
read only from here; the busy flag stays
then report the wallet keys, which are never written
sync the data folder: nothing is left pending
this start set the busy flag, and still writes?
the engine, showing what start-up reported
Steps 3 to 7 are one function, profile::start_up:
Profile::open, profile check and the trace checks
all run this one copy of the order.
(a kill, a panic, a power cut):
the next start finds the busy flag, or no marker,
and runs the barrier before it decides anything.
Every write above leaves the old content or the new,
never a mix, and never nothing where something was.
a check, or nothing to do
